mapper.insert: insert into cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.checked, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, p.name as product_name, p.price as product_price, p.sku as product_image from cart c left join product p on c.product_id = p.id where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 1 order by c.create_time desc
mapper.update: update cart set quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update cart set checked = #{checked}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update cart set status = 0, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1
